messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT (us-east) — Hosted realtime/streaming endpoints experiencing elevated p99 latency and intermittent 502s for us-east customers starting ~2026-04-02T21:12:30Z. Investigating. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1999543210


tayler (oncall): I see a sharp jump in 502s correlated with SYN drops at edge-pop2. Noted an ACL rollout that went to canary at 21:10. Starting containment checks now.

lucas (eng-platform): The new ACL rule is fw-1498; it enforces stricter TCP established checks. I'll roll the rule back on edge-pop2: `infra rollback edge-pop2 --rule fw-1498` and post the job link.

devops-bot: Rollback job created by @tayler at 2026-04-02T21:16:12Z — ci job infra-rollback-1999543210: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/infra-rollback-1999543210

sanjay (eng-sre): Metrics update: error rate peaked ~8.2% and dropped to ~1.1% within 4m after rollback. p99 still ~95ms above baseline; likely connection re-establishment + proxy queue flush.

maria-cs: CS pinged top-10 affected accounts in private threads. Creating an outbound note for customers who reported streaming interruptions. Dedicated/Private deployments were not part of this rollout.

olivia (product): Preparing public status text for support and product channels. Will publish to status when we confirm steady state. Also setting a postmortem target of 48h, assigning RCA.

support-bot: Frontline checklist: 1) capture request_id 2) validate region tag 3) if still 502 -> escalate to #eng-oncall. Playbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/playbooks/edge-acl-guidance

lucas (eng-platform): Edge log excerpt (21:11-21:17Z):
```
21:11:04 edge-pop2 tcp_drop src=203.0.113.45:443->34.56.78.90:52345 reason=established-check
21:15:40 edge-pop2 conn_accept src=203.0.113.45 -> dst=34.56.78.90
```

tayler (oncall): Applied short-term fallback: new streaming sessions from affected prefixes route to us-west for 15m TTL while pools warm. Existing long-lived sessions retained where possible.

sanjay (eng-sre): Continuing to monitor KV cache hit-rate and stream continuity. Error counts trending to baseline; will keep 5m cadence updates here.

olivia (product): Comms plan: 1) status page update (public) 2) targeted email to impacted customers with timeline + mitigation 3) internal RCA in 48h. RCA owner: @lucas; comms lead: @olivia.

incident-bot: Current status: mitigated — rollback plus fallback routing in effect, observed recovery trend. Monitoring window for 30m. Internal incident doc: https://wiki.redwood.ai/incidents/1999543210-acl-streaming-brief. If you see regressions, ping @tayler or reply in this thread. :white_check_mark:
